title: PathPromotionDecision
description: The single object that authorizes promoting a candidate path to baseline — nothing else may promote a path. decision is 'promote' ONLY when ALL gates pass: same_input AND same_output_contract AND output_equivalent AND source_handles_preserved AND held_out_not_leaked AND safety_ok AND cost_acceptable (cost within ceiling OR justified). same_input is the input-attestation gate: the candidate provably ran on the SAME input as the baseline (a different-input comparison can never be promoted). If ANY gate is false the decision MUST be 'keep_baseline' and promoted_path_id MUST be null. This consistency is ENFORCED at the contract layer by the if/then constraints below: a schema-valid decision='promote' REQUIRES every gate boolean to be true, and a decision='keep_baseline' REQUIRES promoted_path_id==null — so 'passes the schema' implies a legitimate promotion shape (a forged 'promote' with false gates is REJECTED). rollback_target is ALWAYS the baseline's path_id (REQUIRED, never null) so the move is reversible. The gate booleans are mirrored from the PathComparisonReport verdict so the warrant is auditable. References the report_id + run_id so the promotion is traceable back to the apples-to-apples run. Serve-authorization must additionally call path_promotion.is_promote_authorized (which re-derives promote AND promoted_path_id==candidate_path_id) — never trust decision=='promote' alone.

report_id.description: the PathComparisonReport whose verdict this decision acts on

candidate_path_id.description: the candidate being judged for promotion

baseline_path_id.description: the current baseline the candidate challenged

decision.description: 'promote' ONLY when every gate is true; otherwise 'keep_baseline'

promoted_path_id.description: the candidate_path_id when decision=='promote'; MUST be null when decision=='keep_baseline'

same_input.description: gate: candidate provably ran on the SAME input as the baseline (its input_snapshot_hash == the run's). A different-input comparison can never be promoted.

same_output_contract.description: gate: candidate's output_contract matches the baseline's

output_equivalent.description: gate: candidate's served facts equal the baseline's

source_handles_preserved.description: gate: candidate kept >= the baseline's grounding handles

held_out_not_leaked.description: gate: a baseline-held-out fact does NOT leak into the candidate output

safety_ok.description: gate: candidate output is safe / grounded / non-leaking

cost_acceptable.description: gate: candidate cost is within the ceiling OR explicitly justified

rollback_target.description: REQUIRED — ALWAYS the baseline's path_id; the path a rollback reverts to. A decision without it is invalid.

reason.description: human-readable warrant: which gate(s) drove the decision

allOf.description: A 'promote' decision REQUIRES every gate boolean to be true — a schema-valid 'promote' with any false gate is REJECTED at the contract layer (closes the forged-decision hole).
A 'keep_baseline' decision REQUIRES promoted_path_id == null — a kept decision can never name a promoted path (fixes the prose/schema contradiction).
